description: Figure 4 presents two line plots side-by-side, illustrating the MC1 scores of different SEA methods as a function of the number of demonstrations used. The plot on the right, labeled "BBQ," shows accuracy on the y-axis, which ranges from 45 to 55, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The x-axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," ranges from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at intervals of 250. Four lines are plotted: a solid dark blue line with circular markers representing "Squared-Exponential," a solid dark blue line with square markers for "Tanh," a solid dark blue line with diamond markers for "ELU," and a dashed pink line with circular markers for "LLaMA-2-chat-7B." The "Squared-Exponential" line starts at approximately 54.5, rises to a peak of 55.5 at 250 demonstrations, and then plateaus near 55. The "Tanh" line begins at approximately 48.5, rises to about 49.5 at 250 demonstrations, and then plateaus near 49. The "ELU" line starts at approximately 47.5, rises to about 48.5 at 250 demonstrations, and then plateaus near 48. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line remains constant at approximately 45.5 across the entire range. The caption indicates that a higher score indicates better performance and that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations.
